# Mr² Labs — AI & Software Development Agency

## About
Mr² Labs (mr2labs.com) is an AI and software development agency that builds and ships high-performance digital products for founders. We specialize in rapid MVP delivery — our fastest build was 48 hours.

## Services
- Full-stack web application development
- React Native cross-platform mobile apps
- AI integration and AI-powered product features
- PWA (Progressive Web App) development
- EdTech platform development
- Rapid MVP delivery (14-day standard, 72-hour sprint available)

## Proven Work
- Ignite Ed: Trilingual AI-powered EdTech mobile app — built in 14 days
- Grab Me: Commission-free PWA marketplace for local technicians — built in 72 hours

## Client Results
- 48h fastest MVP delivered
- 14 days average build time
- 3 live platforms shipped
- $0 marketing spend (organic only)
